rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and API testing that enables AI assistants to interact with REST APIs through their OpenAPI specifications. Built by Amr Salem, it provides tools to fetch API documentation, list and explore endpoints with filtering capabilities, get detailed endpoint information including parameters and schemas, execute authenticated API requests, and validate responses against OpenAPI schemas. Supports multiple authentication methods including API keys, Bearer tokens, and basic authentication with automatic token refresh, making it valuable for API exploration, testing workflows, and integrating external services into AI-assisted development tasks.
